SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.TARGET AS BUYER , A.KEY_1 AS GR_NO , A.KEY_2 AS GR_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND A.TARGET = 'KRWOOS0062' AND A.KEY_9 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT E.TEXT3 AS UNIV_INST_CD, E.TEXT4 AS DEPT_CD, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS PITEM_CD, A.GR_NO||A.GR_SEQ AS PURC_SEQ_NO, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPEC_NM, A.GR_DATE AS PURC_DT, A.UNIT_PRICE AS PURC_UNTPRC, A.ITEM_QTY AS PURC_APNUM, A.ITEM_AMT AS TT_PURC_AMT, '2' AS PURC_PATH FROM ICOMGRDT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPODT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPRDT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PR_NO = B.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ = B.PR_SEQ AND C.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR D ON (1 = 1 AND D.USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 E ON (1 = 1 AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.CODE = D.DEPARTMENT AND E.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'Y' , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_9 = 'N'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'E' , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DOC_NAME = 'GR_DOWN' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_9 = 'N'
